cases.input: A normal execution pins approved request revision, conditions, authority, effectivity, window and target outcomes.
cases.expect: Accepted with immutable pins and distinct request, decision and execution identities.

cases.input: Execution E9 starts with authorizationKind=emergency, no approvedRequestRevisionRef, and relaxedControls, relaxationReason, relaxationAuthorityRef and retrospectiveDueAt populated; status=pending-retrospective-authorization.
cases.expect: Accepted; the revision pin is waived only under the emergency kind and the relaxation record is mandatory.

cases.input: E9 is moved to closed while retrospectiveDecisionRef is absent and retrospectiveDueAt has passed.
cases.expect: Closure is rejected and the undischarged retrospective obligation is reported.

cases.input: E1 pins approvedRequestRevisionRef=R1 but carries no conditionsRef and no effectivity bounds.
cases.expect: Rejected; the invariant requiring the revision and its conditions cannot be satisfied.

cases.input: E4 starts after effectivityTo of the authorization that governs R1.
cases.expect: Rejected; execution must start within the pinned effectivity.

cases.input: Rollback plan P1 is superseded by P2 after E2 has closed; E2 is re-read.
cases.expect: E2 still reports P1 with its revision and digest unchanged; no retroactive rewrite occurs.

cases.input: windowRef and rollbackPlanRef are supplied as bare identifiers with no revision or digest.
cases.expect: Rejected; every pin requires model, id, revision and digest.

cases.input: E2 is created with kind=rollback, revertsExecutionRef=E1 and rollbackPlanRef=P1 pinned; E1 remains partially-completed.
cases.expect: Accepted; E1 and E2 hold distinct identities and the revert link is directed E2 to E1.

cases.input: E1 is transitioned to rollback-started and then rolled-back instead of creating E2.
cases.expect: Rejected; rollback states may not exist on the reverted occurrence.

cases.input: rollbackExecutionRef is set on both E1 and E2 with no kind discriminator.
cases.expect: Rejected; the revert direction and execution kind must be explicit.

cases.input: E2 asserts restored state and closes with verificationRefs empty.
cases.expect: Rejected; rolled back never implies restored without verification evidence.

cases.input: verificationRefs points at a model that is not in the declared reference whitelist.
cases.expect: Rejected; the verification master must be a declared reference target.

cases.input: E5 exists with status=scheduled, windowRef pinned and no startedAt.
cases.expect: Accepted; startedAt is required only from started onward.

cases.input: E5 is set to completed with endedAt absent.
cases.expect: Rejected; every terminal state requires endedAt.

cases.input: E1 is partially-completed with perTargetOutcomes absent, then with outcomes covering two of five targets in targetScope.
cases.expect: Both forms are rejected; partial outcomes must cover the declared scope and no aggregate result is inferred.

cases.input: E6 starts inside freeze interval F-US with no derogation recorded.
cases.expect: Rejected; a freeze prohibition blocks execution start absent a bounded derogation.

cases.input: E6 starts inside F-US under a registered derogation with grantingAuthorityRef, bounded validity and a compensating obligation.
cases.expect: Accepted; the derogation, its authority, bounds and obligation are recorded on the execution.

cases.input: E7 reaches started with no executedWindowRef and no recorded exemption.
cases.expect: Rejected; execution start must cite a window or a recorded exemption.

cases.input: authorityRef points at a WM-ACT-008 window instance.
cases.expect: Rejected; authority resolves only to the decision triad and a window is never authorization.

cases.input: E1 records causedDeploymentRefs=[D1] where D1 is a WM-SFT-009 deployment.
cases.expect: Accepted; deployment, release and execution identities remain separate and the link is causal association.

cases.input: Two correction records cite supersedesRef=E1 with no assertedAt on either.
cases.expect: Rejected; successor assertions require an assertion instant as ordering key.

cases.input: startedAt is supplied as a local date-time with no explicit offset.
cases.expect: Rejected; every instant is RFC 3339 with seconds and an explicit offset.

cases.input: E2 records actingShiftRef intervals for S-EU and S-US and handoverRefs for the A-to-B handover.
cases.expect: Accepted; the acting party at every instant of E2 is recoverable from the execution record.

cases.input: An operator performs a privileged step with operatorRefs empty, or present with no accessGrantRef and no expiry.
cases.expect: Rejected or recorded as an explicit gap; roster membership confers no permission and the grant is a separate audited object.

cases.input: E8 starts against R1 after the operational change request has been recorded as closed.
cases.expect: Rejected; closure asserts no latent or in-flight execution remains.
